title: event fields
description: Something that takes place: a seminar, festival, special lecture or club meeting. It starts at the Item's starts_at (all_day for a whole day); when it ends waits for #10. Open.

category.description: What sort of event it is, as an open name: a client keeps any value of the pattern and offers the examples.

place.description: Where it takes place, as worded by the notice.

organization_id.description: id of the organization Item behind it.

url.description: Where it is published, as a capture url.
